It is all a carefully managed theater by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the scenes.

They want you to buy the mainstream line that the public is asking when it will all end, and then they immediately expose the compliance of the local populations, letting slip that "Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]" 

That trailing silence is the quiet part they almost said out loud. It proves the true, coordinated objectives driving this whole operation forward regardless of whatever stories they feed the manipulated masses.
